name: Hattori Hanzō
role: Sengoku era Samurai and ally of the Tokugawa clan

checks.lead: Hattori Hanzō (服部 半蔵; c. 1542 – January 2, 1597) or Second Hanzō, nicknamed Oni no Hanzō (鬼の半蔵, Damon Hanzō), was a samurai of the Sengoku era. He served the Tokugawa clan as a general and is credited with saving the life of Tokugawa Ieyasu, later helping him to become the ruler of united Japan.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
